scope: literal complete SMH port binding plus smallest native owner/north-front/descriptor transport composition. Full arithmetic, weight service, real program/allocator/result-publication providers are not simulated or physically bound.

model.actual_pin_scope: Actual 27-piece SM floorplan BPin geometry only; provisional component views do not qualify timing

baseline.command_format: exact existing ten little-indexed uint32 seq.hex words; no new ISA
baseline.placement: SM-local control owner; incoming streams end in registered local capture

allocation_port.meaning: actual selected weight-line base, not simulator line-file offset

baseline.latency: per record 10*(request_wait + response_wait) + validate1 + allocationRTT + descriptor_wait + optional X-requestRTT + extent*13 accepted beats + capture1 + ingress/HOPS0 channel3 + real operation/arrive + actual result-publication acknowledgement; stalls measured separately
baseline.serialization: no next record before actual arrive and matching result publication; therefore ring WAR and dependencies cannot overlap
baseline.fanout: one local owner per selected SM; no 32-way combinational broadcast
baseline.admission: not admitted; immutable pinned source/constraints and model integration required
unresolved: program memory and actual DMA client allocation

owner.scheme: two independent registered owners; compare every output and independent per-owner critical-state parity; mismatch immediately gates all effect handshakes and latches abort
owner.logic_cost: second copy of baseline logic; XOR output compare plus two parity reductions over2572 owner-statebits; OR reduction and side-effect gates, not area measured
owner.communication: unchanged external widths; independent cores consume identical accepted source transactions; mismatch cannot acknowledge input or assert external writes/start/completion
owner.fault_scope: single state-bit upset or output disagreement; common-mode faults and coordinated equal parity multi-bit changes not claimed
owner.physical_obligation: no combinational timing assumed: compare tree and gate fanout require actual SS/FF closure; must pipeline/price if needed
open_gates: source/clock separation for independent physical copies
actual ORFS mapped duplicate-bank preservation gate

descriptor.protocol: one parent descriptor outstanding, retained until returned actual south d_valid&&d_ready acceptance; finite credit is not delivery acknowledgement
descriptor.protection: duplicated forward queues, credits, consumption ACK and fault-return chains; compare valid payloads/credits/ACK/fault; complementary pending rails and sticky abort
descriptor.physical_route: Illustrative32hops, not final assignment. Initial obstacle-aware26/32 paths measured3.956-5.016mm with16-31 chain registers under300um bend segmentation; sixpathsblocked. Owner/adapter flight pins and independent dual-rail packing remain unqualified.
descriptor.conservation: no second source send while pending; owner completion waits actual south acceptance + registered return, independent of route latency
open_gates: south bay cell fit and SS/FF

model.weight_service: existing native SMH req_v/req_addr32/req_tag10 and rsp_v/rsp_tag10/rsp_data1088 pass through unchanged; REQCR1 return semantics retained
model.result_service: existing native SMH rv/rrow12/rdata256 passed to real result owner; matching publication receipt required separately
model.release_service: external actual release_in to SMH; never echoed from arrive in production RTL
model.reservation_basis: generous unqualified envelope; DMR flop-only1559.1852um2, actual cell-mapped comb area absent; reserve, do not assert fit
model.pin_plan: 256um north/south edges accommodateactual X planned pin span202.464um within each256um edge. Other control ports use remaining faces. Actual BPin/pinstation/diechannel capacity remains unqualified.
model.FF_setup_clock: 1.2GHz stream clock; protected combinational check remains timing-unqualified; no relaxed SDC assumed
model.replica_latency: local owner three-edge ingress plus existing nativeSMH PIO=2 and fixed X write/read relative margin; producer waits real arrive+publication before next record
